title: OA MONSTERS - the Bakemono: the stat block, the band organization, and the scavenged equipment
audit_comment: OA round ninety-three (capture pp. 254-255): the Chapter 12 monster roster - the Bakemono, the stat block and the description riding together, single-pass pins per the Chapter 9 provenance shift

banner.title: OA MONSTERS - THE BAKEMONO, printed capture pp. 254-255 - the goblin cousins round
banner.provenance: pinned from the 2018 print capture - the sole surviving pass per the R679 provenance shift. THE STAT BLOCK: the uncommon, the 1-100 appearing, the AC 6, the move 6, the HD 1-1, the 40% lair, the treasure A, the 1 attack of 1-6 or by weapon type, the nil specials, the standard magic resistance, the low intelligence, the chaotic evil, the size S, the 1/10 + 1 per hp. THE DESCRIPTION: the western-goblin cousins similar in characteristics and habits; the variety of shapes and sizes, no two alike, the orange-and-red-to-deep-blue skin, the referee's free imagination; the bands for raiding and banditry ruled by an oni or ogre mage; the lieutenant of greater size per 20 members (the HD 2, the AC 4, the D 1-8) commanding absolutely; the abandoned-temples-and-villages lair, the bad repair, the long-deserted appearance, the 40% wooden stockade; the scavenged-not-made equipment doctrine with the seven-row table (the katana 5%, the naginata and short sword 20%, the spear 40%, the tetsubo and short sword 10%, the short sword and shortbow 10%, the chain and shuriken 5%, the kusari-gama and trident 10%); the 20% of a large force at AC 5 from worn pieces unusable by player characters; the four languages; the easily tricked; the sake weakness. The prose codifies per the R431 calculus
banner.sentinel: the gap census after this round: 159 closed, 76 open - the Bakemono box flips (census 628 -> 629); NEXT - R707: the Bisan, Lesser Spirit (capture pp. 255-256), prefix dju (verify free at the landing), audit "R707 OA monsters Bisan audit", include after rules/oa77bakemono.h
